meta.source: Distilled from the study/ knowledge base (SB x RL Study Base), 2026-09-01
meta.translate_policy: 12 frontier/bridge papers get layout-preserving zh translation via SuperTranslate; classics keep EN only (abundant zh resources exist)

categories.01_generative_foundations: 生成模型基础（score / velocity / one-step）
categories.06_sb_x_rl: SB × RL 交叉前沿（选题主战场）
categories.07_radar_2026: 2026 前沿雷达（趋势报告收录的新变量）

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM)
papers.role: 高质量扩散生成范式：forward 加噪 + reverse 去噪 + ε-prediction

papers.title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations (Score-SDE)
papers.role: 连续时间统一框架：forward SDE / reverse SDE / PF-ODE

papers.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
papers.role: velocity matching 范式：把生成变成从 0 到 1 的确定性传输

papers.title: Improving and generalizing flow-based generative models with minibatch optimal transport (OT-CFM)
papers.role: OT-CFM：OT coupling 拉直轨迹，few-step 的前置

papers.title: Mean Flows for One-step Generative Modeling
papers.role: 平均速度场恒等式 → 原生 1-NFE；MP1/DMPO/OFP 的共同基石

papers.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
papers.role: action chunk 上做扩散去噪，机器人操纵的事实标准

papers.title: A survey of the Schrödinger problem and some of its connections with optimal transport
papers.role: SB 数学正典：path-space KL 投影视角与 OT 联系

papers.title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge with Applications to Score-Based Generative Modeling (DSB)
papers.role: neural SB（neural IPF），bridge 算法系的起点

papers.title: Generalized Schrödinger Bridge Matching (GSBM)
papers.role: GSB：边界约束 + 路径 cost，通往 RL 的理论接口

papers.title: Foundations of Schrödinger Bridges for Generative Modeling
papers.role: 面向生成建模的系统性综述（2026）

papers.title: I$^2$SB: Image-to-Image Schrödinger Bridge
papers.role: informative source：把退化图像当 boundary 而非 condition

papers.title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge Matching (DSBM)
papers.role: IMF：交替 Markovian / reciprocal 投影，缓解 DSB 的 path-space 漂移

papers.title: Simulation-free Schrödinger bridges via score and flow matching (SF2M)
papers.role: 免仿真 SDE rollout：SB 变成两个 loss 的回归问题

papers.title: Schrödinger Bridge Flow for Unpaired Data Translation
papers.role: α-IMF 在线更新：单网络免重训迭代，规模化最成熟

papers.title: Adversarial Schrödinger Bridge Matching (ASBM)
papers.role: 对抗式 D-IMF：人脸翻译 SB 采样降到 4 NFE

papers.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms (PPO)
papers.role: clip = trust region 的工程化，on-policy 的事实标准

papers.title: Soft Actor-Critic: Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep Reinforcement Learning with a Stochastic Actor (SAC)
papers.role: max-ent RL：最优策略是 energy-based → SB 熵正则的近亲

papers.title: Mirror Descent Policy Optimization (MDPO)
papers.role: KL 邻近点迭代视角，GSB-MDPO 的直接前驱

papers.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models (GRPO)
papers.role: group-relative advantage 免 critic，R1-style VLA RL 的源头

papers.title: Advantage-Weighted Regression: Simple and Scalable Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning (AWR)
papers.role: advantage-weighted BC：offline 策略提取绕开行为策略密度与概率比的钥匙

papers.title: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
papers.role: 路线 A 起点：trajectory 当 sequence，RL 变条件生成

papers.title: Planning with Diffusion for Flexible Behavior Synthesis (Diffuser)
papers.role: 路线 B 起点：把 planning 整体变成 diffusion + guidance

papers.title: Diffusion Policies as an Expressive Policy Class for Offline Reinforcement Learning (Diffusion-QL)
papers.role: diffusion 进 offline RL 的标杆：Q + BC 双项

papers.title: Diffusion Policy Policy Optimization (DPPO)
papers.role: denoising-as-MDP：对去噪链上的 action 做 PPO，在线微调标杆

papers.title: MP1: MeanFlow Tames Policy Learning in 1-step for Robotic Manipulation
papers.role: MeanFlow 进机器人：1-NFE 策略生成 + Dispersive Loss

papers.title: One Step Is Enough: Dispersive MeanFlow Policy Optimization (DMPO)
papers.role: dispersive 表征正则 + PPO 微调，104.2 Hz Franka 实机

papers.title: One-Step Flow Policy: Self-Distillation for Fast Visuomotor Policies (OFP)
papers.role: 从零自蒸馏免独立预训练教师，无需 JVP

papers.title: Drift-Based Policy Optimization: Native One-Step Policy Learning for Online Robot Control (DBPO)
papers.role: native one-step + online RL，105.2 Hz 控制频率

papers.title: FLAC: Maximum Entropy RL via Kinetic Energy Regularized Bridge Matching
papers.role: 把 SAC max-ent 的策略熵换成动能正则 GSB，绕开生成式 log π

papers.title: Path-Space Mirror Descent for On-Policy Reinforcement Learning under the Generalized Schrödinger Bridge (GSB-MDPO)
papers.role: path-KL 替代动作 KL：proximal 更新搬进 path space，免 log π

papers.title: Rectified Schrödinger Bridge Matching for Few-Step Visual Navigation (RSBM)
papers.role: bridge 上做 rectification：3 步导航，few-step SB 策略实证

papers.title: Bridging Dynamics Gaps via Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge for Cross-Domain Reinforcement Learning (BDGxRL)
papers.role: 跨域动力学差距：SB 做 unpaired 转移翻译

papers.title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow (Rectified Flow)
papers.role: reflow 迭代拉直耦合，few-step 与 RSBM 矫正思想的流侧源头

papers.title: PRISM: Principled Reference Identification for Schrodinger Bridge Model
papers.role: 高斯复原桥参考过程设计理论：不可见性原理 + 共享调度下有限步预算的最优参考谱

papers.title: Soft-constrained Schrodinger Bridge: a Stochastic Control Approach (Soft-SB)
papers.role: 终端约束软化为 KL 惩罚的随机控制解，GSB 路径成本的对照

papers.title: Flow Q-Learning (FQL)
papers.role: flow BC 策略 + 一步蒸馏 actor 做 Q 最大化，offline RL 的 flow 版标杆

papers.title: Consistency Policy: Accelerated Visuomotor Policies via Consistency Distillation
papers.role: 蒸馏路线的一步策略代表，MeanFlow 族要打败的对照

papers.title: Flow-GRPO: Training Flow Matching Models via Online RL
papers.role: ODE→SDE 转换让 flow 有逐步似然，GRPO 直接套上；免 critic 的 flow RL 源头

papers.title: ReinFlow: Fine-tuning Flow Matching Policy with Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.role: 流策略注入可学噪声得逐步高斯似然，DPPO 的 flow 对位物

papers.title: Steering Your Diffusion Policy with Latent Space Reinforcement Learning (DSRL)
papers.role: 冻结解码器、RL 只动 latent 噪声：绕 log π 的第三条路线（噪声空间）

papers.title: OMP: One-step Meanflow Policy with Directional Alignment
papers.role: 方向对齐正则 + 谱分析评幅度响应，一步策略训练信号分析的先例

papers.title: Aligning Flow Map Policies with Optimal Q-Guidance (FMQ)
papers.role: flow map 策略的统一框架 + Q 引导对齐，一步策略 offline-to-online RL 的整合者

papers.title: Mean Flow Policy with Instantaneous Velocity Constraint for One-step Action Generation (MVP)
papers.role: 平均速度策略 + best-of-N 选择做 offline-to-online RL，IVC 边界约束修 MeanFlow 恒等式解不唯一

papers.title: Mean-Flow based One-Step Vision-Language-Action
papers.role: MeanFlow 动作头进 VLA，真机动作生成比 SmolVLA 快 8.7 倍

papers.title: Mean Flow Policy Optimization (MFPO)
papers.role: MeanFlow 策略进 max-ent RL：平均散度网络近似算似然——FLAC 免似然路线的正面对手

papers.title: ReactVLA: Fast and Lightweight Reactive Robot Manipulation via Improved Mean Flow Action Generation
papers.role: 改进 MeanFlow（iMF）+ 注意力残差路由，真机平均延迟 38.6 ms

papers.title: Unified Condition-Action Modeling for Accurate One-Step Action Generation (UCA-Flow)
papers.role: 条件与动作统一 token 序列联合演化，一步生成改善所测任务表现，生成比 MP1 快约 2.3 倍

papers.title: π*0.6: a VLA That Learns From Experience (RECAP)
papers.role: 优势条件化免策略梯度的真实世界 VLA RL，工业界对 log π 障碍的答案

papers.title: Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering: Latent Reinforcement Learning for Generative Policies (LP-DS)
papers.role: DSRL 的扰动约束修正 + 动作熵多模态保持评测

papers.title: DF-ExpEnse: Diffusion Filtered Exploration for Sample Efficient Finetuning
papers.role: DSRL/ResFiT 的探索增强：batch 候选动作按探索兴趣筛选

papers.title: Sample from What You See: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Diffusion Bridge with Observation-Embedded Stochastic Differential Equation (BridgePolicy)
papers.role: 观测嵌入 SDE 从观测先验起步而非噪声：informative source 策略的顶会锚点
